defs.def: to continue doing sth that has already been started; to continue being done 继续做（或从事、进行）

ex.s: Hence, private climate engineering can proceed in relative legal safety.
ex.t: 因此，私人气候工程可以在相对合法的安全状态下进行。

ex.s: He proceeded with the composition until his death in 1827,writing more than 130 musical works, including his Symphony No.
ex.t: 他继续创作直到1827年去世，创作了130多部音乐作品，包括他的《第______交响曲》。

ex.s: Whether I shall ever be cured remains yet to be seen; it is supposed to proceed from the state of my digestive organs, but I am almost entirely recovered in that respect.
ex.t: 我是否能痊愈还有待观察；据说是源自我的消化器官的状况，但我在那方面几乎已经完全恢复了。

defs.def: to do sth next, after having done sth else first 接着做；继而做

ex.s: Afterwards, this young man proceeded to become the world heavyweight champion in 1964, and later changed his name to the one we all knowMuhammad Ali.
ex.t: 后来，这个年轻人在1964年成为了世界重量级拳王，之后改名为我们都知道的名字——穆罕默德\u00b7阿里。

defs.def: to move or travel in a particular direction 行进；前往

ex.s: After Li Daiyu and her cousin arrived in Toronto, the largest and wealthiest city in Canada, they only had a few hours to kill before they had to proceed to the next leg of their trip to Montreal, so they went on a tour of the city.
ex.t: 李黛玉和她的表妹到达加拿大最大最富有的城市多伦多后，在前往下一站蒙特利尔之前只有几个小时可以消磨，于是她们游览了这座城市。

ex.s: In other words, it is a way to proceed from the particular to the general, from the specific to the abstract.
ex.t: 换句话说，它是一种从个别到一般、从具体到抽象的方法。
